answer: An artifact bond ties each identity to one unique marble slab. Polished to a mirror finish, its veins are photographed and hashed, so no two match. A basalt seal binds slab, photo, key in one filing. Auditors recheck a sample each epoch; a rented or copied slab fails the match and burns the 70 bond. Filing costs 45; 1,000 fakes pay 45,000 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool, losing 75,000. An honest agent files once, pays 45, keeps its share.
